summary: v1.0.26 LIVE PRESENCE Phase 2 — end-to-end review PASS across backend spot-checks, webdash Alerts/Summary/Trail/Muster, and mobile Team Presence. BACKEND (13 live HTTP smoke tests, tests/live_v1026_phase2_smoke.py): 13/13 pass — GET /api/presence/alerts?status=open|all|resolved, worker 403 on alerts+muster+shift-summary, muster returns groups {inside,outside,unknown} + counts + generated_at, shift-summary future-date 400, timeline with a real employee returns worker+segments+points, ack→resolve on the live open alert flipped status active→acknowledged→resolved. WEBDASH E2E (demo CGM +919000000500 / OTP 123456, /api/dash/presence): all 4 sub-tab testIDs (prs-tab-live/alerts/summary/muster) render; ALERTS tab: KPI cards for outside_geofence/gone_dark/low_battery/unauthorized_zone rendered (0/1/0/0), the single active alert (Demo Purchase Worker D010 gone_dark) was Acknowledged → status chip stayed 'Signal lost' but Acknowledge button disappeared leaving only Resolve, then Resolved → row removed from open list; ‘Show resolved too’ checkbox brought back 3 rows all with ‘Resolved’ label (2 human, 1 auto-cleared). SHIFT SUMMARY tab: date input, KPIs (16 workers / 14 tracked / 66% avg), 16-row table with coverage bars + zone chips; clicking Demo Accounts Worker navigated to /api/dash/presence/worker/<uuid>?date=… with trail page rendering trail-timeline + 6 tl-seg-* + leaflet map + trail-play + trail-slider + trail-cursor; clicking play advanced cursor from '09:36 pm · Mill Section · 🔋90%' to '10:26 pm · Mill No.5 · 🔋75%' and slider value 0→5, confirming animation. MUSTER tab: 3 columns (muster-col-inside 11 / muster-col-outside 1 / muster-col-unknown 4) with correct worker rows + zone chips; muster-retake changed muster-taken-at from 11:46:28 pm → 11:46:34 pm. MOBILE E2E (390x844 as demo CGM): OTP login OK via CDP Input.insertText on [data-testid=otp-input]; scrolled home and found home-tile-presence (‘Team Presence’), tap navigated to /presence-summary; presence-summary-screen renders Summary + Alerts tabs; Summary shows 10 worker cards with coverage bars + zone chips + ‘14/16 tracked · Coverage 66%’ header; summary-prev-day changed date 'Today' → '2026-09-17' and summary-next-day returned to Today; Alerts tab lists 2 open alerts (outside_factory + signal_lost) with Acknowledge/Resolve buttons — ack+resolve on the first card removed it from the list; ScreenHeader back button returned to /home. WORKER ROLE (Demo Worker D001 +919000000001): home-tile-presence correctly HIDDEN; direct nav to /presence-summary shows ‘Managers only’ access-denied gate. Deprecated packages: NONE observed. SafeAreaView issues: NONE. React Native red screen: NONE.

issues: Red 'Switched OFF for real users: Config-driven home screens — Turn on: Admin → Feature flags' banner still overlays the topbar on every route including /presence/*. Pre-existing (also called out in iteration 27); cosmetic, does not block interactions. Suggest gating behind the same feature-flags check the pilot uses or hiding on the Presence surface.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Consider gating or hiding the red 'Switched OFF for real users' topbar banner on the Presence surface — it draws the eye away from the KPI strip on 1440-wide screens.

(Informational) The webdash acknowledge button click flipped the row from active→acknowledged correctly, but the Chip tone on the /alerts row visually remains a red 'Signal lost' pill (chip is bound to alert_type icon, not status). Only the row.className loses the `.red` styling and the Ack button disappears. This is per spec (status chip shows the alert TYPE, not the workflow state), but reviewers looking for a visual 'acknowledged' colour swap won't find one. Not a bug — flag for spec clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/tests/test_presence_phase2.py — 8 well-scoped tests covering raise/dedupe/hysteresis/auto-resolve + ack/resolve scoping + muster grouping + shift-summary math (coverage %, 10-min tail cap) + timeline segments + audit + worker 403. Matches the spec exactly.

/app/webdash/src/screens/PresenceAlerts.tsx — clean 156-line component; testIDs cover alerts-title, alerts-kpis, alert-kpi-<type>, alerts-table, show-resolved, alert-row-<id>, ack-<id>, resolve-<id>. 15 s auto-refresh + type filter + resolved toggle work as spec.
/app/webdash/src/screens/PresenceMuster.tsx — muster-taken-at + muster-retake + muster-cols + muster-col-<inside/outside/unknown> all present; Print button is a nice UX touch.
/app/webdash/src/screens/PresenceTrail.tsx (inferred from testIDs & DOM output) — trail-timeline + tl-seg-* + trail-play + trail-slider + trail-cursor all render and animate on play.

/app/frontend/app/presence-summary.tsx — presence-summary-screen wrapper, presence-tab-summary/alerts, summary-date + summary-prev-day + summary-next-day + summary-worker-<emp_id> + alert-card-<id> + alert-ack-<id> + alert-resolve-<id> all present; correct gating via role/rank check (worker sees 'Managers only').
/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:483 — home-tile-presence rendered only for rank ≤ 3 (verified: hidden for worker D001, shown for CGM D500).

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 live spot-checks on tests/live_v1026_phase2_smoke.py; main agent's 318-pytest suite untouched)
success_rate.frontend: Webdash 100% (Alerts KPIs+ack+resolve+resolved-toggle; Summary date+KPIs+16 rows+worker→trail; Trail play animates cursor+slider; Muster columns+counts+retake time change). Mobile 100% (login→home tile→presence-summary; Summary 10 cards+date arrows; Alerts 2 cards+ack+resolve; back button; worker-role gate 'Managers only').

seed_data_creation: None. Created /app/backend/tests/live_v1026_phase2_smoke.py (13 pytest cases hitting the sandbox HTTP layer directly, module-scoped session with demo CGM +919000000500 & Demo Worker D001). Note: I acknowledged+resolved one live alert (Demo Purchase Worker D010 gone_dark) during webdash testing; per the scheduler design the minute-sweep will re-raise it while D010 stays silent — this is by design and expected, per the review-request note.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webdash login recipe: [data-testid=login-phone] MUST include +91 prefix (button requires phone.length >= 13); Send OTP btn testID login-send-otp; then [data-testid=login-otp] + [data-testid=login-verify]. Mobile OTP entry: Expo web preview absorbs page.fill on the segmented boxes as a normal string — so page.fill('[data-testid=otp-input]', '123456') sometimes works, but the ROBUST recipe (used here) is CDP Input.insertText: for ch in '123456': cdp.send('Input.insertText', {text: ch}). After 6 chars the verify happens automatically — do NOT try to click [data-testid=verify-otp-button] afterwards, it may already have disappeared. Home tile is below the fold on 390x844 — scroll with page.mouse.wheel a few times to expose home-tile-presence. Trail worker route: /api/dash/presence/worker/<uuid>?date=YYYY-MM-DD. Muster JSON key is generated_at (not taken_at — testID on the DOM is muster-taken-at but the JSON is generated_at, my initial test asserted the wrong key and was fixed). Presence-alerts worker 403 on GET /api/presence/alerts is enforced; muster + shift-summary + timeline all 403 for workers. Stable demo alert subject: D010 Demo Purchase Worker gone_dark (re-raises every sweep because he stays silent).
rca_of_issue: No product bugs found. One test-side assertion drift (muster JSON key `taken_at` → `generated_at`) was fixed in the smoke suite; the frontend testID muster-taken-at is deliberately named after the UX label ('Taken at 11:46 pm'), while the API field is generated_at — this is consistent, not a bug.
